about.title: About
about.subtitle: A bit about who I am and what I do.
about.p1: In 2021, I moved from Barcelona to Prague to join Oracle as a Software Development Engineer. Since then, I have been deeply involved in Visual Builder, a cloud-based platform for collaborative application development, where I focus on delivering robust features and resolving complex technical challenges.
about.p2: After four years abroad, I returned to Barcelona, where I continue to evolve the Visual Builder ecosystem. My current mission focuses on leveraging the latest advancements in AI to deliver robust and efficient solutions. I am also committed to staying ahead by constantly evolving my own workflow and integrating AI tools whenever possible to build faster and smarter.
about.p3: I am a lifelong learner with a passion for exploring emerging technologies. Beyond my daily work, I hold several industry credentials, including the Java SE 8 Oracle Certified Associate, as well as certifications in Java Spring Boot and Artificial Intelligence.

smts.position: Senior Member of Technical Staff at Oracle - IC3
smts.description: Leading the development of features across several areas of the product and resolving critical customer issues. My work focuses on modernizing the Visual Builder ecosystem while evolving my workflow with the latest advancements in AI to deliver refined solutions.

mts.position: Member of Technical Staff at Oracle - IC2
mts.description: Contributed to the core functionality of Visual Builder by developing new features and resolving technical challenges.

freelance.description: Developed key frontend solutions for a B2B media marketplace and a multi-tenant e-commerce platform. Using Angular, I built tools that gave small businesses access to online retailing.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A minimalist gallery of code and design experiments.

monkey.title: Monkey programming language interpreter
monkey.description: A Java 8 implementation of the Monkey programming language, inspired by the book 'Writing an Interpreter in Go', incorporates fundamental features including variable binding, arithmetic expressions, built-in functions, closures, and more.

ngVsSnippets.title: Automatic Angular snippets generator for VSCode
ngVsSnippets.description: A small Javascript library that parses any Angular codebase and generates custom snippets for VS Code editor. I programmed this library when I was working with Angular, as I felt I was constantly looking over the component's properties.
